subject: Fix stale RDB restore counters inflating number_of_indexes metric (#1312)
reason: The change fixes an inflated search_number_of_indexes INFO metric, but the inflated paths are unreachable by the fuzzer. The at-rest over-count requires the non-index RDB_SECTION_GLOBAL_METADATA section, which valkey-search writes only in coordinator mode (the Hidden(), start-up-only, argv-read use-coordinator config plus cluster-enabled); the fuzzer loads modules as bare paths with no module arguments, so coordinator mode can never be enabled, and without it only INDEX_SCHEMA sections exist so rdb_restore_total_indexes == completed at rest and both builds return the same count.
